exposure: total decelerations area in the final 120 min before delivery
duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Women with gestational age greater than 41 weeks, singleton pregnancy, and a category II electronic fetal monitoring (EFM) of at least 30 minutes during the final 120 minutes before delivery
finding: Among women with postdate pregnancies, the total deceleration area and the mean maximum duration of decelerations were negatively correlated with cord blood pH.
